messages:
marta: Quick sync — want to align on SLO-driven routing + quotas and how model-variant fallbacks are surfaced in the console. Proposal: per-customer-tier SLOs (p99 latency + availability) drive routing priority and circuit-breaker triggers. Also need a clear UX for active fallbacks. Thoughts?
aj: +1. Need a deterministic mapping: tier -> latency SLO -> allowed fallback variants -> circuit-breaker thresholds. Quick proposal for numbers to start discussion: enterprise p99=300ms, standard p99=500ms, free p99=1000ms. CBs should consider sustained latency and error rate, not single spikes.
devin: We can't promise strict p99 for larger models at typical seq lengths. Suggest we bucket by token-length profile (short/medium/long) and evaluate p99 per-bucket. CB should be based on sustained tail over sliding window and also include model-specific backpressure signals (e.g., queue length, GPU dispatch errors).
sam: From console/UX side: show an 'active fallback' banner on the route page with current serving variant, trigger reason (latency/error), and a one-click rollback to previous model. Also allow viewing last N switches and the delta in cost/latency.
marta: Agree. How do we author these policies? I sketched a compact YAML config for routing-policy storage: 
```
routing_policy:
  tiers:
    enterprise:
      p99_latency_ms: "300"
      cb_window_s: "120"
      cb_threshold_error_rate: "0.02"
      fallback_chain: ["r-l2-opt","r-l2-quant"]
    standard:
      p99_latency_ms: "500"
      cb_window_s: "120"
      cb_threshold_error_rate: "0.05"
      fallback_chain: ["r-l2-quant","r-l1"]
    free:
      p99_latency_ms: "1000"
      cb_window_s: "120"
      cb_threshold_error_rate: "0.1"
      fallback_chain: ["r-l2-quant","r-base"]
```
This keeps policy readable for console and ops.
aj: Two notes: (1) cb_thresholds should be configurable per-region (different infra). (2) We need an explicit cost-penalty field so billing/console can estimate unit-cost impact when a fallback occurs.
observability-bot: Alert: routing-cb customer=acme-corp tier=standard region=us-east breached threshold (3/5 windows). p95_latency=820ms, p99_latency=1200ms. Link: https://o11y.internal/redwood/alerts/12345
devin: For telemetry, we should emit the following metrics/events: routing.choice{customer,tier,region,model_variant}, routing.cb_state{0/1}, routing.cb_reason{latency|errors|capacity}, routing.switch_event with before/after variant and window stats. Also emit histogram buckets for token-length so we can backfill.
sam: Console mock: timeline per-route that shows SLO breaches, fallbacks, and cost delta. Tooltip on each switch: last 3 window stats + top causes. Also a quick "force pin variant" action for enterprise users.
marta: Nice. Next steps: aj to draft API changes + numeric thresholds per-region, devin to prototype metrics/events and a simple CB operator in staging, sam to mock UI banner + timeline and cost-delta card. Sync Tue 10am. @aj @devin @sam please ack.
aj: :thumbsup: ack
devin: ack — I'll push a staging PR for metrics by end of week.
sam: I'll drop a Figma link tomorrow and include the banner copy variations.
ops-bot: Heads-up: rolling deploy of routing-controller to canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC — watch autoscaling and cb metrics.
